The Exiled Cheating Magician Enjoys an Unrestrained Second Life.: I Can Give "Strengthening Points" Not Only to Weapons, But Also to Everything, and I Can Unlock the Effect at Any Time of My Will, But are the Rest Okay?
The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a New Life
meta.description:
Rain Garland, an enchantment mage belonging to the ‘Fangs of the Royal Beast’, one of the continent's five great guilds, was suddenly expelled from the guild one day. Filled with bitter disappointment at being betrayed by those he trusted, Rain retrieved all the Enhancement Points he had placed on the guild's armor. He then tried applying them to his own sword and clothes instead the cheap copper sword gained destructive power rivaling legendary blades, and the simple cloth garments gained defense comparable to orichalcum!? Moreover, Rain's enchantment magic held a cheat-level secret that allowed it to evolve even further!?

After meeting new companions like the renowned beautiful knight Lily, who came upon hearing rumors of Rain, and the noble lady Martina, a candidate for the title of Hero, Rain begins to grow into a great adventurer...!?

videos.title: Everyone Knows What It's Like When Nothing Goes Right, but What Do I Do When That Happens? Why, It's Obvious! I Run and Scream My Head Off!
videos.overview: Rein is unceremoniously kicked out of the Beast's Fangs, so he decides to become an adventurer.

videos.title: The Enhanced Clothes I Was Wearing Were Destroyed by a Devastating Blow, and a Traumatized Girl in Casual Clothes Hit Me With All Her Might.
videos.overview: With help from legendary adventurer Lily Flambert, Rein defeats a mid-level dragon.

videos.title: When I Went to Apologize With a Friend Who Was a Shut-In for Two Years, We Were Unexpectedly Served Apple Bunnies, so I Think She’s Been Forgiven.
videos.overview: When Rein and Lily return to town, they meet Margaret, whose sister once adventured with Lily.

videos.title: There’s Something I’ve Learned From Ending Up Naked Twice... When You’re Naked, You Get Bitten Twice.
videos.overview: Rein's old guild learns he dispelled their enchantments, and Cornelius hires an assassin.

videos.title: A Girl Who Wants You to Know She Really Can Cook Despite the Lack of Cooking Scenes Draws and Wreathes Her Sword in Flames.
videos.overview: Margaret loses her mind after reading a note that reads, "Lily Flambert killed us."

videos.title: You’re Persistent, Girl... You Haven’t Changed at All, and You’re Powerless to Do Anything Again... But Still, I Am Lily Flambert!
videos.overview: Lily overcomes her fear of fighting, while Mirabelle struggles with her own change of heart.

videos.title: I’ve Never Been to That Bakery Before, so I’ll Take This Opportunity to Stuff My Face With Melon Bread and Walk a Dog, Wahoo.
videos.overview: Margaret is excited to join the Blue Crystals, but she shuts down again when she believes she's been mislead.
